root_cause: The gateway is incorrectly applying a standard credit card MDR rate to RuPay Credit UPI transactions, which are mandated to be zero-fee under RBI guidelines.
diagnosis: All 7 transactions in this group show a fee_charged amount greater than zero while the expected_fee is Rs 0.00, indicating that the payment processor is failing to recognize the RuPay Credit UPI instrument as a zero-fee rail and is instead charging the merchant the standard credit card interchange rate.
action_rationale: Since the fees were charged in violation of the zero-fee mandate for RuPay Credit UPI, the merchant is entitled to a full refund of the overcharged MDR amounts.
